targetText: Ideas, etc. are subjective, while deeds or actions are the subjective translated into the objective, but both represent the dynamic role peculiar to human beings. We term this kind of dynamic role "man's conscious dynamic role", and it is a characteristic that distinguishes man from all other beings.
summary: While material conditions set the stage and limits of what is possible, conscious human action and strategy are required to turn the possibility of victory into reality.
explanation: Mao distinguishes dialectical materialism from mechanical fatalism: objective conditions do not automatically produce victory without human agency, planning, and active struggle grounded in objective facts.
context: Even when an economic crisis weakens the ruling class, social change does not happen automatically unless workers consciously organize and act.
